units.statement: theorem L2_slotDecomp {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (hstrict : ∀ f g, f ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 → σ.w f < σ.w g → σ.w (f + g) = σ.w f) (hjump : ∀ f g, f ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 → f + g ≠ 0 → σ.w f = σ.w g → σ.w f < σ.w (f + g) → σ.R f + σ.R g = 0) (hneg : ∀ f, σ.R (-f) = - σ.R f) : SlotDecomp σ

Now carries them as explicit hypotheses (they are StageCore fields, so every core-provenance stage supplies them; base constructs them concretely — no circularity: this unit does not consume StageCore). DERIVATION: equal-weight slots at piece γ have distinct z-positions p_j(γ) = (j − tγ)/e (hS5 forced positions + hStretch + hbez = anchorCong/stride); partial-sum induction: a weight jump would force R-sum = 0 (hjump), contradicting GRb distinct-position independence; vanishing partial sum forces term = −(prefix) and hneg + GRb again contradicts; so weights stay at γ, hRadd applies termwise (DECOMPOSITION), and a vanishing Y-combination is termwise zero (INDEPENDENCE).

units.statement: theorem L2_P6i {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ : Stage p F) (hcore : StageCore σ) (γ : ℤ) : (∀ f f', f ≠ 0 → f' ≠ 0 → σ.w f = γ → σ.w f' = γ → σ.R f = σ.R f' → f - f' = 0 ∨ γ < σ.w (f - f')) ∧ (∀ f f', f ≠ 0 → f' ≠ 0 → f + f' ≠ 0 → σ.w f = γ → σ.w f' = γ → σ.w (f + f') = γ → σ.R (f + f') = σ.R f + σ.R f') ∧ (∀ (û : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (c : ↥σ.FQ), û ≠ 0 → c ≠ 0 → inC σ.Φ û → σ.R û = LaurentPolynomial.C (Subfield.inclusion σ.hFQ_le c) * LaurentPolynomial.T (0 : ℤ) → ∀ f, f ≠ 0 → σ.w f = γ → û * f ≠ 0 → σ.R (û * f) = LaurentPolynomial.C (Subfield.inclusion σ.hFQ_le c) * σ.R f) ∧ (∀ f, f ≠ 0 → σ.w f = γ → σ.R f ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (σ.slotImages γ)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (σ.slotImages γ), x ≠ 0 → ∃ f, f ≠ 0 ∧ σ.w f = γ ∧ σ.R f = x)

units.statement: theorem L4_TRANSviii_a {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Type*} [Field F] [Finite F] (σ σ' : Stage p F) (hcore : StageCore σ) (g : ℕ) (Φhat : Polynomial ℤ_[p]) (hΦdeg : Φhat.natDegree = σ.e * g * σ.Φ.natDegree) (e' h' : ℕ) (zbar : Fˣ) (htrans : TransitionCore σ σ' Φhat e' h' zbar) : (∀ W' : ℤ, (∃ B, B ≠ 0 ∧ inC Φhat B ∧ σ'.wPrev B = W') ↔ (∃ (γ : ℤ) (j : ℕ), (∃ C, C ≠ 0 ∧ inC σ.Φ C ∧ σ.w C = γ) ∧ j < σ.e * g ∧ W' = γ + (j : ℤ) * σ.h)) ∧ (∀ (γ : ℤ) (j : ℕ), (∃ C, C ≠ 0 ∧ inC σ.Φ C ∧ σ.w C = γ) → j < σ.e * g → ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ c : (↥σ'.K)ˣ, ((c : ↥σ'.K) : F) ∈ σ'.FQ → ∃ B, B ≠ 0 ∧ inC Φhat B ∧ σ'.wPrev B = γ + (j : ℤ) * σ.h ∧ σ'.w B = (σ'.e : ℤ) * (γ + (j : ℤ) * σ.h) ∧ ∃ d : (↥σ'.K)ˣ, σ'.R B = LaurentPolynomial.C (d : ↥σ'.K) * LaurentPolynomial.T (- σ'.t * (γ + (j : ℤ) * σ.h)) ∧ ((d : ↥σ'.K) : F) = ((c : ↥σ'.K) : F) * ((zbar ^ m : Fˣ) : F))
